|game_text=If [[A Stunning Move / A Valuable Hostage (V) (Virtual Block 7){{!}}A Stunning Move]] on table, deploy on [[Coruscant: Palpatine's Quarters{{!}}Palpatine's Quarters]] (if [Virtual Block 5] [[We Have A Plan / They Will Be Lost And Confused{{!}}We Have A Plan]] on table, this card always relocates to Palpatine if possible (even if a captive)); opponent may deploy a Jedi and/or a lightsaber here. [[Evil Is Everywhere]]: Opponent may not Force drain here. Adds one [Dark Side] at same site. If just lost, relocate to [[Blockade Flagship: Prison]]. Once per turn, if a player controls this site, they may have this card (unless on Palpatine) follow their first character to move from here using landspeed or docking bay transit to a non-shielded site.

* '''Original''' (this page): text as given in the Virtual Block 7.3 release sheet (official text as of 3 June 2011; the surviving copy was re-made 25 July 2011)<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock7_3">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock7_3.pdf#page=3 Virtual Block 7.3 release sheet] ("Official text as of June 3, 2011"; copy re-made 25 July 2011), page 3, slip 13 (position on the sheet; the slip prints no number). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261022223058/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock7_3.pdf#page=3 Internet Archive]</ref>: “If A Stunning Move on table, deploy on Palpatine’s Quarters (if [Virtual Block 5] We Have A Plan on table, this card always relocates to Palpatine if possible (even if a captive)); opponent may deploy a Jedi and/or a lightsaber here. Evil Is Everywhere: Opponent may not Force drain here. Adds one [Dark Side] at same site. If just lost, relocate to Blockade Flagship: Prison. Once per turn, if a player controls this site, they may have this card (unless on Palpatine) follow their first character to move from here using landspeed or docking bay transit to a non-shielded site.” The Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB7-D-insidiousprisoner-pre.gif]]) and the release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB7-00-Insidious_Prisoner.png]]) print it.
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Insidious Prisoner (Virtual Block 7) (Errata)]]): the PC website card list (from 21 July 2012, the earliest archived capture with text, to 11 January 2013) shows “Evil is Everywhere” and “Once per turn, it a player controls this site” (typo kept as published)<ref name="cl-VBlock7-2012-07-21">Players Committee website card list (VBlock7Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064742/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock7Type.html 21 July 2012] (Internet Archive); same text in every capture to [https://web.archive.org/web/20130111152155/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock7Type.html 11 January 2013]</ref>: “If A Stunning Move on table, deploy on Palpatine’s Quarters (if [Virtual Block 5] We Have A Plan on table, this card always relocates to Palpatine if possible (even if a captive)); opponent may deploy a Jedi and/or a lightsaber here. Evil is Everywhere: Opponent may not Force drain here. Adds one [Dark Side] at same site. If just lost, relocate to Blockade Flagship: Prison. Once per turn, it a player controls this site, they may have this card (unless on Palpatine) follow their first character to move from here using landspeed or docking bay transit to a non-shielded site.” No published card image shows this text; the image of that page is a CardMaker recreation ([[:File:VB7-00-Insidious_Prisoner-PC-E1-cardmaker.png]]).
* '''PC-E2''' ([[Insidious Prisoner (Virtual Block 7) (Errata 2)]]): the Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013, Dark Side p. 35) has “before drawing a starting hand opponent may ▼ a Jedi and/or a lightsaber here” instead of “opponent may deploy a Jedi and/or a lightsaber here”, with the release-sheet wording otherwise restored<ref name="ml-ds">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_DS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Dark Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf#page=35, page 35. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170704232650/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf#page=35 Internet Archive]</ref>: “If A Stunning Move on table, deploy on Palpatine’s Quarters (if [Virtual Block 5] We Have A Plan on table, this card always relocates to Palpatine if possible (even if a captive)); before drawing a starting hand opponent may ▼ a Jedi and/or a lightsaber here. Evil Is Everywhere: Opponent may not Force drain here. Adds one [Dark Side] at same site. If just lost, relocate to Blockade Flagship: Prison. Once per turn, if a player controls this site, they may have this card (unless on Palpatine) follow their first character to move from here using landspeed or docking bay transit to a non-shielded site.” The Master List slip ([[:File:VL-history-1273-13-front-master.png]], errata mark E) prints it. The Players Committee posted this errata on its rules forum on 24 July 2013, effective immediately, from Design and Development<ref name="pcforum-p823692">Players Committee forum, Rules board, thread “Current Rulings/Errata” (t=36574, now titled “Current Rulings Archive August 2012 - December 2015”), post by darkjediknight11, 24 July 2013 ([https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=36574&start=20#p823692 forum post])</ref>, so this version dates from then (the Master List that prints it was compiled until February 2014).
